FROM node:22-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY frontend/package.json frontend/package-lock.json* ./

COPY frontend/ ./

# Default to dev Caddyfile; production compose overlay can mount the prod one.
COPY Caddyfile.dev /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
EXPOSE 80 443
